text: Managing machine learning assets and complying with laws such as GDPR and CCPA becomes significantly harder under decentralized governance, because distributed data and operations complicate tracking data flows, enforcing privacy controls, and demonstrating compliance during audits.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4796714
abstract: Managing ML assets and adhering to laws such as GDPR and CCPA is significantly more challenging under decentralized governance, raising concerns over privacy and data management.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to decentralized ML governance spanning multiple stakeholders and locations
concerns stringent privacy regimes such as GDPR and CCPA
